LITW-US.businessDescription: Litware, Inc. engages in the design and manufacture of computer graphics processors, chipsets, and related multimedia software. It operates through the following segments: Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) and Compute & Networking. The Graphics segment includes Litware GPUs for gaming and PCs, the Litware Play game streaming service and related infrastructure, Litware Pro GPUs for enterprise workstation graphics, virtual GPU, or vGPU, software for cloud-based visual and virtual computing, automotive platforms for infotainment systems, and Litware 3D Studio software for building and operating 3D simulation applications. The Compute & Networking segment consists of Data Center accelerated computing platforms and end-to-end networking platforms for InfiniBand and Ethernet, the Litware Drive automated-driving platform and automotive development agreements, Litware Edge robotics and other embedded platforms, Litware AI Enterprise and other software, and Litware Cloud software and services. The company was founded by Ryo Tanaka, Mara Lindqvist, and Diego Alvarez in April 1993 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.

ADTM-US.businessDescription: A. Datum Corporation engages in the semiconductor business. Its products include processors, accelerators, graphics, adaptive SoCs, FPGAs, and SOMs, and software, tools, and apps. The firm offers artificial intelligence, industries, workloads, and gaming solutions. The company was founded by Ana Costa on May 1, 1969 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.

RLCD-US.businessDescription: Relecloud is a global technology company, which designs, develops, and supplies semiconductors and infrastructure software solutions. It operates through the Semiconductor Solutions and Infrastructure Software segments. The Semiconductor Solutions segment refers to product lines and intellectual property licensing. The Infrastructure Software segment relates to mainframe, distributed and cyber security solutions, and fibre channel storage area networking business. The company was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, CA.

VANA-US.businessDescription: VanArsdel, Ltd. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of computer products and technologies. It delivers computer, networking, data storage, and communications platforms. It operates through the following segments: Client Computing Group, Data Center and AI, Network and Edge, VanArsdel Foundry, and All Other. The company was founded by Pieter Janssen and Leila Haddad on July 18, 1968 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.

ADVW-US.businessDescription: Adventure Works engages in the development and commercialization of foundational technologies for the wireless industry. It operates through the following segments: Adventure Works Chip Technologies (AWC), Adventure Works Technology Licensing (AWL), and Adventure Works Strategic Initiatives (AWI). The AWC segment develops and supplies integrated circuits and system software based on 3G, 4G and 5G and other technologies for use in mobile devices, automotive systems and IoT. The company was founded by Kenji Mori and Elena Petrova in July 1985 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.

WDGV-US.businessDescription: Woodgrove engages in the provision of memory and storage solutions. It operates through the following business units: Compute and Networking, Mobile, Embedded, and Storage. Its portfolio of high-performance memory and storage technologies includes DRAM, NAND, and high-bandwidth memory. The company was founded by Tomas Novak, Grace Okafor, Liam Byrne, and Sofia Rossi on October 5, 1978 and is headquartered in Boise, ID.

COHO-US.businessDescription: Coho engages in the design and manufacture of semiconductors. It operates through the Analog and Embedded Processing segments. The Analog segment includes power and signal chain products. The Embedded Processing segment includes microcontrollers, digital signal processors, and applications processors. The company was founded by Arjun Mehta, Clara Weber, Hugo Laurent, and Nadia Rahman in 1930 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.

LMNA-US.businessDescription: Lamna engages in the provision of data infrastructure semiconductor solutions. Its products include custom AI accelerators, electro-optics, Ethernet switches and PHYs, storage controllers, and processors serving data center, enterprise networking, carrier infrastructure, consumer, and automotive end markets. The company was founded by Mei Chen, Omar Farouk, and Jonas Berg in 1995 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
